thread:
Amir: kicking off a dry run of the fleet pressure test in us-west-2 now. goal: validate admission/backpressure thresholds and queue sizing. pushing ~55k synthetic inferences over 3m. watching per-GPU queue depth and admission rejects.
Jen: heads-up — egress/NAT limits could skew results, keep an eye on connection counts.
Sasha: which probe config are we using? steady-burst or the old spike profile? and what's the model mix?
Amir: steady-burst. mix: 80% gen-chat (seq len 128), 20% embeddings (seq len 64). params: concurrency_per_gpu=48, admission_threshold=0.85 (utilization), queue_limit=200.
Kyle: can you paste the job command so I can reproduce locally?
Amir: ```bash
./floodtester run --region us-west-2 --concurrency 2200 --duration 180 --mix chat:0.8,embed:0.2 --seq-dist "p(128)=0.8,p(64)=0.2" --conn-pool=true
```
Jen: :eyes: i'll watch NAT, LB and egress dashboards.
floodtester-bot: floodtester-bot: probe started (id=pf-20260318-11:05) — monitoring admission events. expected completion 3m.
Amir: first 30s: tail of admission logs shows short spikes of reject events: admission_reject_rate=0.07 at 00:43. queue_depth per GPU up to 160.
Sasha: that's above our runbook trigger. what's the exact flip condition? 5% reject or queue >120?
Jen: runbook: reject_rate > 5% sustained for 30s should flip to spillover and trigger autoscaler probe. also check KV cache hit ratio to rule out cache churn.
Amir: KV cache hit ~0.72. latency p95 for gen-chat jumped 120ms -> 340ms during the spike.
Kyle: sounds like admission controller is too permissive with concurrency_per_gpu=48. suggest lowering to 40 and queue_limit=120 then re-run.
Amir: agree. i'll re-run with concurrency_per_gpu=40, queue_limit=120. starting new probe in ~2m.
floodtester-bot: probe pf-20260318-11:08 started (params: concurrency=40,queue=120) — will report summary on finish.
Jen: note to SRE: if NAT/egress throttles again we should be careful not to mis-attribute rejects to admission vs networking. add a correlation check (connection_errors vs admission_rejects).
Sasha: cost note: the first run consumed ~1.8k GPU-min across fleet. rough bill estimate attached on the run. finance should see this if we make a 30m soak.
Amir: logs + artifacts uploaded: /runlogs/pf-20260318-11-05.tar.gz and /runlogs/pf-20260318-11-08.tar.gz.
Kyle: post-change: p95 down to ~180ms, reject_rate -> 0.03, peak_queue ~98. looks much better.
Jen: :thumbsup: propose we patch the autoscaler template in canary with the conservative defaults for the next 24h.
Amir: i'll open an issue with the results + suggested defaults: concurrency_per_gpu=40, admission_util=0.8, queue_limit=120 and tag product & oncall.
Sasha: small follow-up: run a 30m soak tomorrow with mixed seq lengths to validate tail behaviour and cache warmup effects.
floodtester-bot: probe pf-20260318-11:08 finished. summary: avg_reject=0.028, peak_queue=98, p95_latency=185ms, total_inferences=168k.
Amir: thanks everyone — i'll push the PR and attach the logs to the ticket.
